---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new project, algorithm, or feature idea for the portfolio
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or learning gap is. (e.g. "I want to learn how offline RL works but there are no offline RL projects in this portfolio.")

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the algorithm, environment, and visual UI layout.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches or existing frameworks you have considered.

**Educational Value**
Why would this feature or project make a good addition to the portfolio? What are the key RL concepts it teaches?

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockup images, or papers related to the proposed feature.
